people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Darius
people.line: Persian king who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

translations.web: Then Darius the king made a decree, and the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon, was searched.
translations.bsb: Thus King Darius ordered a search of the archives stored in the treasury of Babylon.
translations.kjv: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
